name: Bolt Ironcore
lore: Reclaimed from Neon Crucible, Bolt broke his factory oath to defend living towns. His iron chassis folds into the ancient saw that once built the Crossroads bridges.

primary.name: Piston Jab
primary.description: Extend a mechanical fist at foes directly ahead: 30 damage within 100 units.

secondary.name: Missile Volley
secondary.description: Launch four guided missiles in a short volley. Each travels visibly, turns toward a foe and deals 14 direct damage plus 6 splash to other foes within 58 units. Walls stop missiles.

special.name: Iron Tempest
special.description: Fold into a giant spinning saw for 6s (0.45s to transform). Touching the 78-unit blade deals 12 damage every 0.3s. Move at 42% speed; no dodge or normal attacks. Primary becomes Shock Stomp: 16 damage within 170, 0.4s stun then 2.5s slow, with a 2.6s cooldown. Take 30% less damage while transformed. Each enemy you defeat during the form adds 1 second to its remaining duration.

passive: Overclock Reserve: three successful Piston Jabs prime the next Missile Volley with one extra missile. Missing a jab gives no charge.

technique.name: Armored Tempest
technique.description: Saw form reduces damage taken by 45% instead of 30%, but contact damage is 20% lower.

final_technique.name: Railcore Driver
final_technique.description: Replace missile volley with a charged piercing rail lane for 46 damage. No homing or explosion, but can hit a row of enemies.

attack.name: Railcore Driver
attack.description: Replace missile volley with a charged piercing rail lane for 46 damage. No homing or explosion, but can hit a row of enemies.
